IMAGINED: allow the nameless narrator thoughts, feelings, wants, small worries, body sensations, morning weather, light, sounds, smells, small gestures and unnamed neighbours. At most two short everyday lines by unnamed people, each with a speech tag; no facts, numbers or names in dialogue. Do not invent names, numbers, dates, places, trade partners, prices, rules, beliefs or rituals.
fixtureSnapshots.scriptText: This is an imagined market morning. My fingers tighten around a stone. The balance tilts, so I move it gently. An unnamed neighbour says, "Take your time." I loosen my grip. Morning light reaches the edge of the balance, and the market murmurs around me. The stone settles beneath my hand. The weights were only roughly alike from place to place, with significant variability. Many small weights were likely used for light goods. The hands, the light and the neighbour's everyday words are imagined; the weight findings are the factual baseline.
